description: Owner-controlled MOCK testimonials. Restored verbatim (all 8 records, as they were) from the former getFallbackTestimonials() array in src/pages/Testimonials.jsx. They are never shown to normal visitors: they are seeded as real DB documents with visible=false and this tag, and only appear in owner preview mode. The owner can add, publish, unpublish or delete them at any time from Dashboard > Testimonials.
